component.name: CategoryPill
component.script:
sub init() m.bg = m.top.findNode("bg") m.border = m.top.findNode("border") m.lbl = m.top.findNode("lbl") end sub
sub onContentChange(nv as dynamic) it = m.top.itemContent if it = invalid then return m.lbl.text = it.title + " " + it.description if it.shortDescriptionLine1 = "1" m.border.color = "0x7C3AEDFF" else m.border.color = "0x00000000" end if end sub
sub onFocusChange(nv as dynamic) p = m.top.focusPercent if p > 0.5 m.bg.color = "0x7C3AEDFF" m.lbl.color = "0xFFFFFFFF" else m.bg.color = "0x1F1F1FFF" m.lbl.color = "0xE5E7EBFF" end if end sub
